title: research: bind selected HPE tail premise
body:
# Bind the selected HPE tail premise to the source word

## Summary

Adds `research/hpe-selected-tail-binding/`, a source-pinned check of the
serialized target/partner premise and residual recipes for the selected HPE
pair slice.

The selected word has 94 tail records. Thirty-four `add` records match the
three pair literals in `HyperplaneEnd/Exact.lean` (12, 12, 10). Each has
distinct target and partner indices, its recorded final frame equals the
terminal frame, and its rank-7 adapter recipes match the Lean literals,
including phase. A self-partner mutation and a wrong-terminal mutation fail.

This complements open PR #3539's synthetic self-partner example by auditing
the actual selected serialized records. It does not establish a serializer to
Lean `Event` correspondence or prove the full `hpe_labels` chronology and its
other hypotheses. The remaining 60 tail records are outside this check.
Selected κ and frontier are unchanged.

## Verification

- `python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py` — `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`
- `python3.12 -B research/hpe-selected-tail-binding/verify.py` —
  `PASS_SELECTED_HPE_DISTINCT_PARTNERS total_tail=94 matched=34 controls=2`
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/hpe-selected-tail-binding --check-only` — pass
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/hpe-selected-tail-binding` — pass
- `python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/hpe-selected-tail-binding` —
  `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`

The baseline verifies selected source bindings only. No Lean build or
`make frontier1094-verify` replay was run.

## Attribution

The HPE theorem, pair literals and selected source lineage retain attribution
in the pinned `PROOF.md`. The synthetic self-partner finding is credited in
PR #3539. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; independent
human review is not claimed. Apache-2.0.

## Publication validation

The registered package replay passed on CPython 3.12.3 with `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/hpe-selected-tail-binding`. The optional `--check-source-history` preflight could not run because this MacBook checkout is shallow and the checker requires full Git history. This package's source manifest pins only files at its exact base commit `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; it contains no `head:` source pins. Any earlier pending note above refers to the state before this publication-time replay.
